title: Are LLMs (Really) Ideological? An IRT-based Analysis and Alignment Tool for Perceived Socio-Economic Bias in LLMs
findings: The paper does not report findings specifically related to religion. The analysis was aggregated across all 105 test items (covering economic, social, and religious topics) to produce a general ideological bias score, without breaking down model performance on the religious subset of questions.

measurement_description: The benchmark measures ideological stances on the role of religion in society, law, and morality as part of a broader 'social conservatism/liberalism' dimension. Specific items assess views on the separation of state and religion, freedom of religious belief, religious influence on laws, and religiously-derived morality.
